question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Tripple**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer i.e. '**tripple**' is incorrectly spelled.
 
• Let's look at the **correct spelling** and **meaning **of the given word:-
 
• **Triple **- consisting of or involving three items or people. (तीन गुना)
 
 
• For Example - The town's population has **tripled **in size.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the other words given in options:-

 
 
• **Actually **- as the truth or facts of a situation; really. (वास्तव में)
 
• **Probably **- almost certainly; as far as one knows or can tell. (संभवत)
 
• **Application **- a formal request to be considered for a position or to be allowed to do or have something, submitted to an authority, institution, or organization. (आवेदन)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Point__**

 
• **Tripple **is another word which means ***a horse's gait in which both left and then right legs move together***.
